learning_objective: Read one fact: the time a gate opens.
instructions_en: Read the note. Pick the time.
prompt_en: The vehicle gate opens at seven thirty. What time does it open?
content_en: The vehicle gate opens at seven thirty.
explanation_en: The note gives one time: seven thirty.
explanation_pl: Notatka podaje jedną godzinę: siódma trzydzieści.

instructions_en: Read the note. Pick the number.
prompt_en: Bring two water cans to the gate. How many cans go to the gate?
prompt_pl: Ile kanistrów ma trafić pod bramę?
content_en: Bring two water cans to the gate.

learning_objective: Read one simple order: the place to go.
instructions_en: Read the order. Pick the place.
prompt_en: Move to the north gate. Where do you go?
explanation_en: The order names the north gate.

learning_objective: Find the route that is in use, not the one that was cancelled.
instructions_en: Read the note. Pick the road you use.
instructions_pl: Przeczytaj notatkę. Wybierz drogę, z której korzystasz.
prompt_en: Use the west road today. Do not use the north road. Which road do you take?
content_en: Use the west road today. Do not use the north road.
explanation_en: The note tells you to use the west road and not the north road.
explanation_pl: Notatka każe jechać drogą zachodnią, a nie północną.

learning_objective: Tell a new supply from one that already arrived.
instructions_en: Read the note. Pick what arrives at noon.
instructions_pl: Przeczytaj notatkę. Wybierz, co przyjeżdża w południe.
prompt_en: The water arrived yesterday. The fuel arrives at noon. What comes at noon?
content_en: The water arrived yesterday. The fuel arrives at noon.
explanation_en: Noon is the time given for the fuel, not the water.

learning_objective: Read a simple change of plan.
instructions_en: Read the note. Pick what changed.
instructions_pl: Przeczytaj notatkę. Wybierz, co się zmieniło.
prompt_en: The patrol keeps the same route. It will leave one hour later because of the rain. What changed?
content_en: The patrol keeps the same route. It will leave one hour later because of the rain.
explanation_en: The route stays. The departure is one hour later.
explanation_pl: Trasa zostaje. Wyjazd jest o godzinę później.

learning_objective: Follow the order of three steps and name the middle one.
instructions_en: Read the note. Pick the second step.
prompt_en: Load the fuel first. Then load the water. Move only after both are on the truck. What is the second step?
content_en: Load the fuel first. Then load the water. Move only after both are on the truck.
explanation_en: The sequence is fuel, then water, then movement. Water is second.
explanation_pl: Kolejność to paliwo, potem woda, potem ruch. Woda jest druga.

instructions_en: Read the note. Pick the cause.
prompt_en: The patrol stopped because the map showed the wrong track. The radio was working. Why did the patrol stop?
content_en: The patrol stopped because the map showed the wrong track. The radio was working.
explanation_en: The cause is the wrong track on the map. The radio is a side fact.
explanation_pl: Przyczyną jest zła droga na mapie. Radiostacja to informacja poboczna.

learning_objective: Follow what happens after the first radio step.
instructions_en: Read the note. Pick the next action.
prompt_en: Call the gate first. After the gate answers, report the delay. What do you do after the gate answers?
content_en: Call the gate first. After the gate answers, report the delay.
explanation_en: The call comes first. The report comes after the answer.
explanation_pl: Najpierw jest wywołanie. Meldunek jest po odpowiedzi.

learning_objective: Separate the real reason for holding from a reason the note rejects.
instructions_en: Read the note. Pick the reason you are holding.
prompt_en: Hold at the bridge because the deck is damaged. Do not hold because the order changed; the order is the same. Why are you holding?
content_en: Hold at the bridge because the deck is damaged. Do not hold because the order changed; the order is the same.
explanation_en: The reason to hold is the damaged deck. The order did not change.
explanation_pl: Powodem postoju jest uszkodzony pomost. Rozkaz się nie zmienił.

learning_objective: Read a restriction that applies to one group and not another.
instructions_en: Read the note. Pick who may use the track.
instructions_pl: Przeczytaj notatkę. Wybierz, kto może korzystać z drogi.
prompt_en: The forest track is open to vehicles. It is closed to foot patrols until the mud dries. Who may use the track now?
prompt_pl: Kto może teraz korzystać z drogi?
content_en: The forest track is open to vehicles. It is closed to foot patrols until the mud dries.
explanation_en: Vehicles may use it. Foot patrols may not, until the mud dries.
explanation_pl: Pojazdy mogą jechać. Patrol pieszy nie, dopóki błoto nie wyschnie.

learning_objective: Keep the requested action apart from background detail.
title_en: What you are asked to do
instructions_en: Read the note. Pick the action it asks for.
instructions_pl: Przeczytaj notatkę. Wybierz działanie, o które prosi.
prompt_en: The meal truck is late, and one passenger is missing. Send a short report to the duty desk before you search the area. What must you do first?
content_en: The meal truck is late, and one passenger is missing. Send a short report to the duty desk before you search the area.
explanation_en: The requested action is the report. The search comes after it.
explanation_pl: Oczekiwane działanie to meldunek. Szukanie jest później.

learning_objective: Identify the backup inside a short report.
instructions_en: Read the report. Pick the backup.
prompt_en: The bridge is closed, so the column cannot cross. We are holding on the east bank. If the bridge is still closed at noon, we will use the ford. What is the backup?
content_en: The bridge is closed, so the column cannot cross. We are holding on the east bank. If the bridge is still closed at noon, we will use the ford.
explanation_en: The backup is the ford at noon. Holding is the action now.
explanation_pl: Plan zastępczy to bród w południe. Postój to działanie teraz.

learning_objective: Resolve two readings and keep the one the note confirms.
instructions_en: Read the exchange. Pick the message that stands.
instructions_pl: Przeczytaj wymianę. Wybierz komunikat, który zostaje.
prompt_en: I said the column would arrive at six. You read it as sixteen. Confirming: arrival is at six, not sixteen. Which time stands?
content_en: I said the column would arrive at six. You read it as sixteen. Confirming: arrival is at six, not sixteen.
explanation_en: The confirmation keeps six and rejects sixteen.
explanation_pl: Potwierdzenie zostawia szóstą i odrzuca szesnastą.

learning_objective: Track situation, effect, action, and backup in one handover.
title_en: What you tell the next shift
instructions_en: Read the handover. Pick the line that matches it.
instructions_pl: Przeczytaj przekazanie. Wybierz zdanie, które do niego pasuje.
prompt_en: Situation: one radio is dead. Effect: we cannot reach the north gate. Action: we are using the spare set. Backup: a runner goes if the spare set fails. Which line is right?
prompt_pl: Które zdanie jest zgodne z przekazaniem?
content_en: Situation: one radio is dead. Effect: we cannot reach the north gate. Action: we are using the spare set. Backup: a runner goes if the spare set fails.
explanation_en: The spare set is the action in progress. The runner is only the backup.
explanation_pl: Zapasowa radiostacja to działanie teraz. Łącznik jest tylko planem zastępczym.

options.text_en: The spare set is in use now.
The north gate can hear us.
